			<font style="display: inline;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;text-align:center;border-top:1pt none #D9D9D9 ;border-bottom:1pt none #D9D9D9 ;font-family:Arial;font-weight:bold;font-size: 10pt">
			<a name="Part1"></a><font style="display: inline;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">PART I</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;border-top:1pt none #D9D9D9 ;font-family:Arial;font-weight:bold;font-size: 10pt">
			<a name="Item1"></a><font style="text-indent:0pt;margin-left:0pt; padding-right:23pt;"><font style="display: inline;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">ITEM 1.</font></font><font style="text-indent:0pt;margin-left:0pt; padding-right:4pt;text-align:left"><font style="display: inline;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">BUSINESS </font></font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">Overview</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">We are an education company that accelerates learning by applying proven research on how the brain learns in online and on-premise software solutions. Our results show that learners who use our products can realize achievement gains of up to 2 years in as little as 3 months and maintain an accelerated rate of learning even after product use ends. We provide our learning solutions primarily to U.S. K-12 schools in traditional brick-and-mortar, virtual or blended learning settings and also to parents and learning centers, in approximately 45 countries around the world. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-family:TimesNewRomanPSMT;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-family:TimesNewRomanPSMT;">We are highly differentiated because of our focus on the &#x201C;science of learning&#x201D; - </font><font style="display: inline;">combining advances in the field of brain research with standards-based learning objectives to achieve dramatic student gains</font><font style="display: inline;font-family:TimesNewRomanPSMT;">. &nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;">At December 31, 2013, proof that our products produce substantial academic gains was demonstrated in 282 efficacy studies, including randomized controlled trials and longitudinal studies, representing results from approximately 130,000 aggregate participants. These studies show gains for students at all K-12 grade levels, for at-risk, special education, English language, Title I (low income, under achieving), and a variety of other students. Gains have been demonstrated throughout the United States and in ten other countries. The studies show that these gains endure over time.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-family:TimesNewRomanPSMT;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-family:TimesNewRomanPSMT;">In 2011, we began implementing a software as a service (SaaS) model. Our easy-to-use and easy-to-access web-based platforms are able to effectively deliver individualized learning opportunities to a large number of students simultaneously. </font><font style="display: inline;">Our </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> and </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Reading Assistant </font><font style="display: inline;">educational software products are now available on our browser-based </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">SciLEARN </font><font style="display: inline;">Enterprise</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;">software platform and our on-demand platform </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">MySciLEARN</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;">On</font><font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;">Demand. The </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">SciLEARN </font><font style="display: inline;">Enterprise</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;">and</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;"> MySciLEARN </font><font style="display: inline;">platforms meet the needs of institution and district-wide installations by providing scalability, remote access, centralized reporting, asynchronous online professional development, and ease of administration for multiple campuses.&nbsp; </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">Markets</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Our products are available worldwide to educational institutions, speech and language clinics, learning centers and parents. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">United States K-12 Market</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Our sales are concentrated in K-12 schools in the United States, which in 2013 were estimated to total over 130,000 schools serving approximately 50&nbsp;million students in almost 14,000 school districts. In the last three fiscal years, the U.S. K-12 sector has represented approximately 84% of our sales. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">We sell our products primarily at the district level.&nbsp;&nbsp;We also sell to building-level principals and lead teachers for smaller initial purchases. After these initial implementations, we then seek to expand throughout the school and/or district based on the demonstrated efficacy of the products. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">We market our products primarily as learning acceleration solutions, to be used in a blended model with existing teaching and curriculum materials, at both the elementary and secondary school levels. Despite a national focus on reading and increased school district accountability, independent evaluations of student performance have demonstrated little improvement in reading results. According to the U.S. Department of Education (USDE), in 2013, 65% of fourth graders in the United States failed to achieve a &#x201C;proficient&#x201D;&nbsp;level in reading and 32% performed below&nbsp;the &#x201C;basic&#x201D; level.&nbsp;&nbsp;United States K-12 public schools are funded primarily through state and local tax revenues, but also receive funding from the federal government through a variety of programs, many of </font>
		</p>
		<p><font size="1"> </font></p><div style="width:100%">

		<p style="margin:0pt;text-align:center;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">

			<font style="display: inline;">1</font>

		</p>

</div><hr size="3" style="color:#999999" width="100%" align="center"></hr><p style="page-break-after:always">&nbsp;</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;;font-size: 10pt"><font style="display: inline;">which target children who are poor and/or are struggling academically. The funding for a substantial portion of our K-12 sales has historically come from federal sources, in particular, </font><font style="display: inline;">IDEA (Individuals with Disabilities Education Act) grants </font><font style="display: inline;">and Title I funding. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">This funding is subject to legislative adjustment, such as the sequestration cuts that went into effect in 2013.&nbsp; </font><font style="display: inline;">The National Education Association estimates that the federal sequestration that went into effect on March 1, 2013 reduced Title I funding by $740 million and IDEA special education funding by $632 million in the 2013-14 school year.&nbsp;&nbsp;Sequestration had a negative impact on our sales in 2013, though most of this funding has been recently restored.&nbsp; </font><font style="display: inline;">The amount of federal funding varies from time to time, as do the rules governing the use of this funding; the temporary additional American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (ARRA) education funding expired in 2011.&nbsp;&nbsp;There has been much discussion about changes to the federal</font><font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;">No Child Left Behind Act, and the administration has granted 42 states and the District of Columbia waivers from certain requirements, but there has been no legislative agreement on significant changes.&nbsp;&nbsp;State and local funding for schools continues to be significantly impacted by decreases in tax revenues due to the recent recession. While education spending remains an important priority, at least 34 states are providing less funding per student for the 2013-14 school year than they did before the recession started in 2008,</font><font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;">resulting in teacher layoffs, program restrictions and overall expense reductions, although funding is expected to increase in approximately 60% of states in the 2013-2014 school year. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Other Markets</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">In addition to selling to K-12 schools, we also sell to and through private practice professionals and learning centers. These speech, language and other professionals recommend the use of our products to appropriate clients and then supervise the use of the software, often in connection with their other services. In 2013, over 400 non-school professionals and entities in the United States and Canada (North America) offered our products. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">We also sell web-based products and tutoring services directly to parents branded as BrainPro. Our BrainPro products are designed to meet the needs of learners who want to &#x201C;catch up&#x201D; and are delivered via a SaaS (software as a service) model. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Sales to countries other than the United States and Canada are a small but growing part of our business, which we serve through a network of value-added resellers (VARs). During 2013, products were marketed to customers in approximately 45 countries. As of December&nbsp;31, 2013, we were represented by 26 VARs. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Our strategy for international markets thus far has been conservative, so that we do not divert resources from the U.S. K-12 market. However, we believe the potential international opportunity is significant. Outside of North America, our products are used in three primary applications: (1) assisting in the acquisition of English as a second language, (2) by clinical professionals with impaired children, and (3) in tutoring and learning centers to strengthen academic skills.&nbsp;&nbsp;About one-fourth to one-third of the worldwide population now understands and speaks English to some degree, and English is the international language of business, travel, and diplomacy. While </font><font style="display: inline;">our</font><font style="display: inline;"> products, in and of themselves, do not provide all the components necessary to teach English to non-native speakers, they have been demonstrated to be extremely effective in assisting in English language instruction, through building the necessary underlying cognitive, acoustic processing, fluency and other skills needed to learn and speak English. Strategic initiatives with VARs in China and Southeast Asia have included the creation of franchise-based, &#x201C;business-in-a-box&#x201D; learning center models where our products are augmented by direct instruction and other supplementary activities to achieve measurable results in English improvement for students age 5-14.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">Products </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Our products unify advances in the field of brain research with standards-based learning objectives to achieve enduring student gains. Our solutions augment any curricular approach and when blended with high-quality teacher-led instruction, build learning capacity by systematically and rigorously developing the academic and cognitive skills required for lifelong learning success.&nbsp; </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;text-decoration:underline;">Fast ForWord</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">The components of our flagship </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord </font><font style="display: inline;">product were built on the foundation that </font><font style="display: inline;font-family:TimesNewRomanPSMT;">the learning brain can improve through exercise - the concept of brain fitness</font><font style="display: inline;">. &nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;">These components apply learning principles that have been established through neuroscience and cognitive research as critical to learning new tasks:&nbsp;&nbsp;frequency and intensity of exercises, adaptively to the students&#x2019; individual performance, timely motivation and simultaneous development of multiple skills.&nbsp; </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> is now web-based, improving its ease-of-use, access and overall effectiveness. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> Language and Literacy</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> Language for elementary learners and </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> Literacy for adolescent learners build foundational reading and language skills to help districts move below grade level learners to be successful learners in the general classroom.&nbsp;&nbsp;These components include </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord </font><font style="display: inline;">Language, </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord </font><font style="display: inline;">Language to Reading,</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;"> Fast ForWord </font><font style="display: inline;">Literacy</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;"> and Fast ForWord </font><font style="display: inline;">Literacy Advanced.&nbsp;&nbsp;These products build learning capacity through developing cognitive skills using exercises focused on the oral language skills underlying reading.&nbsp;&nbsp; </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">

		</p>
		<p><font size="1"> </font></p><div style="width:100%">

		<p style="margin:0pt;text-align:center;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">

			<font style="display: inline;">2</font>

		</p>

</div><hr size="3" style="color:#999999" width="100%" align="center"></hr><p style="page-break-after:always">&nbsp;</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;;font-size: 10pt"><font style="display: inline;">The exercises in the </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord </font><font style="display: inline;">Language component specifically focus on oral language comprehension and listening, including phonological awareness, listening accuracy and comprehension, working memory, and familiarity with language structures.&nbsp;&nbsp;The content and exercises of the Literacy component are similar to those of Language, but have been adapted to maximize impact for adolescents and English language learners.&nbsp; </font><font style="display: inline;">The </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord </font><font style="display: inline;">Language to Reading product helps students make the link between spoken and written language, using exercises that focus on listening comprehension, sound letter recognition, phonological awareness, beginning word recognition and English language conventions.</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;">The</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;">Literacy Advanced software includes content and exercises similar to those in the </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord </font><font style="display: inline;">Language to Reading with a user interface that is designed to appeal to adolescents, emphasizing phonemic awareness, decoding, word recognition, sequential and inferential comprehension and the ability to sequence multi</font><font style="display: inline;">&#8209;step instructions.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> Reading</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;text-decoration:underline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> Reading builds learning capacity through developing cognitive skills using exercises focused on critical &#x201C;reading to learn&#x201D; abilities. The </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> Reading exercises focus on phonemic awareness, phonics and decoding, spelling, vocabulary, fluency and comprehension.&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> Reading begins with</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;">Reading Readiness, which prepares the student for reading, focusing on phonemic identification, categorization and blending, letter names, sound and letter correspondence, rapid letter/word recognition, and oral vocabulary.&nbsp; </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> Reading continues with levels 1 through 5, which focus on reading skills and tasks of increasing complexity.&nbsp;&nbsp;The exercises in Reading 5 carry a significant working memory load, as they build vocabulary, improve critical thinking and abstract reasoning, improve composition skills, and focus on accuracy, fluency and comprehension. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;text-decoration:underline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;text-decoration:underline;">Reading Assistant products</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Reading Assistant</font><font style="display: inline;"> provides a one-on-one reading tutor for every learner. This unique software combines advanced speech verification technology with scientifically-based interventions to provide help just when a learner needs it, strengthening their reading fluency, vocabulary and comprehension.&nbsp;&nbsp;Reading fluency is the ability of a student to read quickly enough to garner meaning from a text, and is reported to have a high correlation with overall reading proficiency. However, to become a fluent reader, students must frequently read aloud and receive timely feedback and assistance with their reading. Providing effective fluency training for all students is a challenge in the classroom because teachers do not have enough resources and/or time to give the consistent and rigorous one-on-one attention a child needs to improve his or her reading fluency. </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Reading Assistant </font><font style="display: inline;">addresses this problem by acting as a personal tutor &#x2013; saving time for teachers and engaging learners. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;text-decoration:underline;">ResultsNow! </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">ResultsNow!</font><font style="display: inline;"> is our online hosting and support solution for our </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> and </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Reading Assistant</font><font style="display: inline;"> products.&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">ResultsNow! </font><font style="display: inline;">includes web-based initial training, access to Student Progress Reports and Reading Progress Indicator, SciLEARNU eLearning Courses, technical and instructional support and SaaS hosting on our </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">MySciLEARN </font><font style="display: inline;">platform.&nbsp;&nbsp; </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Student Progress Reports are our online data reporting tools, which allows customers to monitor individual, classroom, school or district performance.&nbsp;&nbsp;Reading Progress Indicator is a reliable and valid assessment of a student&#x2019;s reading skills. It is designed to be quick and convenient to administer before and after product use, to rapidly demonstrate the effectiveness of our products and place students in the right product sequence.</font>
		</p>

		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">The </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">BrainPro</font><font style="display: inline;"> services are based on </font><font style="display: inline;">our flagship </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord </font><font style="display: inline;">product.</font><font style="display: inline;"> &nbsp; &nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">BrainPro</font><font style="display: inline;"> services are targeted at learners who are below grade level and want to catch up.&nbsp; </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">BrainPro</font><font style="display: inline;"> learners access </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> from home and work with a certified tutor remotely. The </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">BrainPro</font><font style="display: inline;"> tutor is responsible for defining a customized program and goals and helping the learner achieve progress toward the learning goals with the help of the parents.&nbsp;&nbsp;The BrainPro Autism services include a more intense and customized version of tutoring services.</font>

			<font style="display: inline;">We believe that training and implementation support is important to achieving appropriate product use in schools, where a limited school day and competing priorities makes it challenging for educators to devote the time and resources needed for a solid implementation. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Services</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">To facilitate effective implementation, we offer on-site product training, technical installation, implementation management, consulting, and web-based synchronous and asynchronous professional development services.&nbsp;&nbsp;We host a spectrum of both live and web-based forums, workshops, and seminars for customers and prospective customers. At these gatherings, speakers provide information on advances in research on how the brain learns, and current customers offer actual case studies on how </font><font style="display: inline;">our</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;">products impact student achievement. These sessions also provide </font><font style="display: inline;">our customers</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display: inline;">with opportunities to network and develop informal support relationships. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Support</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">For customers who purchase our support services, we provide software technical update releases, and extensive telephone, email, and chat support. Through our new </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">MySciLEARN</font><font style="display: inline;"> platform and our customer support website, we provide extensive web-based implementation and technical resources.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">Warranty</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">We generally provide a warranty that our software products operate substantially as described in the manuals and guides that accompany the software for a period of ninety&nbsp;days. The warranty excludes damage from misuse, accident, and certain other circumstances. To date, we have not experienced any significant warranty expense.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">Sales and Marketing </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">We sell to our principal market, K-12 schools and districts throughout the United States and Canada, using a diversified direct sales channel, including both inside and field sales personnel. We emphasize our highly differentiated message of &#x201C;accelerating learning&#x201D; through web-based marketing efforts to reach more educators quickly while targeting specific audiences with research results and success stories most relevant to their areas of responsibility and expertise. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Although our focus on improved sales force productivity includes a balance of smaller sales with shorter cycles to get started in new accounts, the majority of our annual booked sales are from existing customers who have a year or more of positive experience with our programs, expanding to new sites and adding products and services to existing sites. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">We sell to clinical professionals and learning centers principally through direct marketing (mail, web and telesales) and conferences (both industry conferences and an annual forum we conduct ourselves). In 2009, we began selling directly to parents online with our remote tutoring service, </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">BrainPro</font><font style="display: inline;">. &nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">We also maintain a network of independent VARs outside North America. As of December&nbsp;31, 2013, we had relationships with 26 VARs. To date, booked sales outside North America have not been significant. We are building this channel in response to the growing demand for English fluency around the world. We believe that our </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> and </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Reading Assistant </font><font style="display: inline;">products offer unique value in quickly &#x201C;rewiring&#x201D; the brain for English. We also believe that the international market has significant potential growth opportunities, and we are positioning ourselves to take advantage of these in the future.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">Competition</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Districts and schools employ a wide variety of learning programs and methods for their students. The market for supplemental and intervention educational products is fragmented and competitive, with no single company or product with a dominant market share. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">The critical factors for K-12 school districts are the perceived ability of the product to improve student performance, impact teacher productivity and fit into the traditional school day. Attributes that influence the district&#x2019;s assessment of these factors include the ability to deliver measurable improvements in student achievement, cost, ease-of-use, reputation, existing relationships with customers, completeness of the product offering, ability to provide effective and efficient product implementation, and ability to work with the other components of the school curriculum. We believe that generally we compete favorably on the basis of these factors.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Our patented products are highly differentiated by their proven results and focus on the development of learning capacity. With recent improvements in ease-of-use and access, we compete vigorously for available funding against other companies offering educational </font>
		</p>
		<p><font size="1"> </font></p><div style="width:100%">

		<p style="margin:0pt;text-align:center;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">

			<font style="display: inline;">4</font>

		</p>

</div><hr size="3" style="color:#999999" width="100%" align="center"></hr><p style="page-break-after:always">&nbsp;</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;;font-size: 10pt"><font style="display: inline;">products and programs, as well as with providers of traditional methods of teaching. Many of the companies providing these competitive offerings are much larger than us, are more established in the school market than we are, offer a broader range of products to schools, and have greater financial, technical, marketing and distribution resources than we do. Competitors may enter our market segment and offer actual or claimed results similar to those achieved by our products. In addition, although the traditional approaches to learning are fundamentally different from the approach we take, the traditional methods are more widely known and accepted and, therefore, represent significant competition for available funds.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">Product Development; New Products </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">The markets in which we compete are characterized by frequent product introductions and evolving educational standards and approaches. Our future success will depend in part on our ability to continue to enhance and update our existing products and to develop and successfully introduce new products.&nbsp;&nbsp;Most of our development leadership and personnel is located at our headquarters in Oakland, California.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">During the fourth quarter of 2013, as part of our strategy to improve the efficiency of our development operations and to better align our costs and organizational structure with the current economic environment and improve our profitability, we implemented a plan to discontinue our development operations in China.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our plan is to consolidate development in the United States.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Our research and development expenses were approximately $3.8 million, $7 million and $10.3 million for the years ended December&nbsp;31, 2013, 2012 and 2011, respectively.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Development Strategy</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Over the past several years, our development efforts have been primarily focused on transitioning our products to a web-based platform and enhancing that platform and increasing its ease of use. The first milestone in this effort was achieved in 2010 with the release of </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">SciLEARN</font><font style="display: inline;"> Enterprise, a browser-based platform hosted by the school district or learning institution. In 2011 we released </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">MySciLEARN</font><font style="display: inline;">, a browser-based platform hosted by us. These two platforms achieve our plan to roll out hosted offerings that expand our per student licensing option to the broader U.S. K-12 market and that we believe will more effectively address newer markets outside U.S. K-12.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">In 2012, we launched the Reading Assistant product on the </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">SciLEARN</font><font style="display: inline;"> Enterprise and </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">MySciLEARN</font><font style="display: inline;"> platforms and continued to mature and expand </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">MySciLEARN</font><font style="display: inline;">.&nbsp; </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">In 2013, we focused on developing our </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">MySciLEARN</font><font style="display: inline;"> platform to be more robust, scalable and easier to use.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition, we expanded the reporting and analytical features of </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">MySciLEARN </font><font style="display: inline;">and continued to enhance</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;"> Reading Assistant </font><font style="display: inline;">performance.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">During 2014, our primary product development goal is to enable the use of our </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> Language, Literacy and Reading products on the iPad &#xAE; mobile digital device.&nbsp;&nbsp; </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>

		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">Intellectual Property </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Our intellectual property strategy addresses both product technology and product concepts. Our policy is to protect our proprietary rights in our products and technology through a combination of patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secret laws, confidentiality procedures, and contractual provisions.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">At December&nbsp;31, 2013, we held the rights to 66 issued and active patents and 10 pending applications. These include 43 issued U.S. patents and 5 pending U.S. applications that we own or co-own. We also held 5 issued patents from other countries and had 5 applications pending abroad. We were the exclusive licensee under 11 issued U.S. patents and 7 issued foreign patents. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Our U.S. patents relating to the </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;"> products expire between 2014 and 2026; the </font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Reading Assistant</font><font style="display: inline;"> patents expire in 2024.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">The 18 patents that we license are owned by the Regents of the University of California (&#x201C;the Regents&#x201D;) and Rutgers, the State University of New Jersey (collectively the &#x201C;University patents&#x201D;), and relate to the basic speech and sound modification and adaptive technology developed at those institutions. In 2013, approximately 50% of our product booked sales was derived from selling products that use the licensed inventions. This license is exclusive and extends for the life of the University patents, which expire in 2014, subject to the right of the Regents to terminate in case of default and our right to terminate at any time upon 60&nbsp;days written notice. If we were to lose our rights under this license, and if the Regents were to assert these patents against us,&nbsp;&nbsp;our business could be materially harmed.&nbsp;&nbsp;This license requires payment of royalties based upon cumulative net booked sales of our products, subject to certain minimum royalty amounts. For the remainder of the license term, the minimum annual royalty payment is $150,000. In fiscal 2013, 2012 and 2011, we had approximately $0.2 million, $0.2 million and $0.4 million, respectively, in royalty expense under the license. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">

		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;;font-size: 10pt"><font style="display: inline;">We also have 19 U.S. trademark registrations, including registrations for marks including &#x201C;</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Fast ForWord</font><font style="display: inline;">,&#x201D; our most important trademark.</font>

			<font style="display: inline;">On March 21, 2014, the company sold seven US patents to a third party.&nbsp;&nbsp;See Note 19 to the consolidated financial statements for further discussion..</font>

		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Posit Science Corporation </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">In September 2003, we transferred certain aspects of our technology to Posit Science Corporation (PSC) for use in the healthcare field. PSC&#x2019;s products based on our technology primarily focus on combating age-related cognitive decline and enhancing cognitive abilities as people age. The transaction included a license of the patents we own and certain software we developed, a sublicense of the patents we license from the universities, and the sale of some research-related assets. All of the rights licensed to PSC are limited to a specified healthcare field and most of the licenses were exclusive in that field. For these rights, PSC paid us a one-time initial fee, issued us shares in PSC and has an ongoing royalty obligation. PSC also agreed to cross</font><font style="display: inline;">&#8209;license any patents issued to PSC. We retain all rights to our technology outside of the specified healthcare field.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">In December 2013, we amended our license agreement with PSC to make most of the exclusive licenses non-exclusive. In exchange for the change in the licenses, we agreed to significantly reduce PSC&#x2019;s ongoing royalty obligation.</font>

Historically, our booked sales have been lowest in the first and fourth quarters of the year and highest in the second or third quarter of the year.</font><font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>

These deferred revenues are primarily composed of professional development and technical services that have not yet been performed and the portion of multi-year sales, subscription and term-based sales, support and Progress Tracker sales not yet recognized as revenue. Approximately $9.7 million of our deferred revenue as of December 31, 2013 is expected to be recognized within the next 12 months.</font>

</div><hr size="3" style="color:#999999" width="100%" align="center"></hr><p style="page-break-after:always">&nbsp;</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;;font-size: 10pt"><font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;"></font><a name="Item1A"></a><font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;">Item 1A. Risk Factors </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;text-align:center;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">RISK FACTORS</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">The following factors as well as other information contained in this report should be considered in making any investment decision related to our common stock. If any of the following risks actually occurs, our business, financial condition and results of operations could be materially and adversely affected and the trading price of our common stock could decline.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:12pt 0pt 0pt;border-bottom:1pt none #D9D9D9 ;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Sales of our products depend on the availability and extent of government funding for public school reading intervention purchases, which is variable and outside the control of both us and our direct customers. If such funding becomes less available, our public school customers may be unable to purchase our products and services on a scale or at prices that we anticipate, which would materially and adversely impact our revenues and net income.&nbsp; </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:12pt 0pt 0pt;border-top:1pt none #D9D9D9 ;border-bottom:1pt none #D9D9D9 ;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:normal;">United States public schools are funded primarily through state and local tax revenues, which are devoted primarily to school building costs, teacher salaries and general operating expenses. Public schools also receive funding from the federal government through a variety of federal programs, many of which target children who are poor and/or are struggling academically. Federal funds typically are restricted to specified uses.&nbsp; </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:12pt 0pt 0pt;border-top:1pt none #D9D9D9 ;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:normal;">The funding for a substantial portion of our K-12 sales typically comes from federal sources, in particular IDEA (special education) and Title I funding.&nbsp;&nbsp;The amount of this funding varies from time to time, as do the rules governing the use of this funding.&nbsp;&nbsp;The federal budget deficit and competing federal priorities could adversely impact the ongoing level of federal education funding.&nbsp;&nbsp;There has been much recent discussion, and the administration has granted 42 states and the District of Columbia waivers from certain requirements, but there has been no legislative agreement about changes to the No Child Left Behind Act of 2001.&nbsp;&nbsp;A cutback in federal education funding or a change in the funding rules to allow general rather than restricted uses of federal funding could have a materially adverse impact on our revenue.&nbsp; </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">In August 2011, President Obama signed the Budget Control Act of 2011, which provided for both an increase in the federal government's borrowing authority and reductions in spending.&nbsp;&nbsp;Under the Budget Control Act of 2011, Congress was required to&nbsp;&nbsp;develop legislation to achieve further deficit reduction.&nbsp;&nbsp;Legislation passed in early January 2013 averting the &#x201C;fiscal cliff&#x201D; merely postponed the deficit reduction requirements, and Congress subsequently failed to achieve the required level of deficit reduction.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result, automatic reductions in spending across-the-board (also known as &#x201C;sequestration&#x201D;) became effective on March 1, 2013.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result of this sequestration, funding for federal education programs was cut by approximately 5.1% across-the-board during the 2013-2014 school year.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our fiscal year 2013 was significantly negatively impacted by the sequestration cuts.&nbsp;&nbsp;The fiscal year 2014 appropriations restored most, but not all, of the funds from the sequestration cuts made to Title I grants and special education state grants for the next two years.&nbsp;&nbsp;However, Congress will need to reach a broader agreement before the 2016-2017 school year to permanently restore these funds. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:12pt 0pt 0pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:normal;">Any other action or inaction by Congress that significantly reduces federal education funding, whether through across-the-board funding cuts or otherwise, would have a materially adverse effect on our financial condition, results of operations, and cash flows. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:5pt 0pt;font-family:Helvetica;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">State education funding continues to be significantly impacted by state budget difficulties. According to the Center on Budget and Policy Priorities, in the 2013-2014 school year, elementary and high schools in at least 15 states are receiving less state funding than in the prior school year, and at least 34 states are providing less funding per student for the 2013-2014 school year than they did before the recession started.&nbsp;&nbsp;These reductions have resulted in teacher layoffs, program restrictions and overall expense reductions. While education spending remains an important priority for states, it faces competition from demands for, among other things, relief for the unemployed and rising healthcare costs. Continued pressure on state budgets and state education funding could have a materially adverse impact on our revenue. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-justify:inter-ideograph;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Our cash flow is highly variable and may not be sufficient to meet all of our objectives. We need additional financing in the future in order to continue our operations and as a result, there is uncertainty about our ability to continue as a going concern.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Our cash and cash equivalents were $2.6 million at December 31, 2013, compared to cash and cash equivalents of $2.3 million at December 31, 2012.&nbsp;&nbsp;On April 5, 2013, we entered into a subordinated note and warrant purchase agreement with certain existing stockholders for an aggregate principal amount of $4.6 million to provide us additional working capital.&nbsp;&nbsp;We have used cash from operations of $3.2 million, $10.5 million and $7.2 million in the years ended December 31, 2013, 2012 and 2011, respectively. Our existing cash and cash equivalents and expected cash flow from operations and the sale of patents may not provide sufficient liquidity to fund our operations and capital expenditures for the next 12 months. As such, there is uncertainty about our ability to continue as a going concern.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our independent registered public accounting firm concluded that there is substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern.&nbsp;&nbsp;Accordingly, it included an explanatory paragraph to that effect in its report on our December 31, 2013 consolidated financial statements.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;"> &nbsp; </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
